properties.decision:
Anthony, 2026-09-11: "yes to option b, use the corpus as the test." Option (b) of dec:idea-a-problem-in-the-users-words-should-retrieve-the-tool-that-answers-it — question-shaped phrasing carried ON the tool, in the served description, so find_tools can match the user's register rather than only the operation's name.

WHAT IS DECIDED: every served tool whose description does not already contain the words a user would state its job in gains one sentence that does — "ask for this when you want to …" in plain terms — additive, no rename, no consumer break. The 180-query criterion-1 corpus (one query per tool, in a user's words) becomes a committed acceptance test: each tool must reach find_tools' default top 5 for its query.

WHY (b) AND NOT THE OTHERS, measured: after the scorer fix (chg:find-tools-matches-whole-words-…) 42 of 180 still miss, and 12 of those have ZERO word overlap between the query and anything on the tool — add_requirement ← "write down something the system must do", graph_report ← "give me the overall health summary". No ranking change reaches them; only carrying the register on the tool does. (c) rename was rejected as a migration for a retrieval problem; (a) harvesting sharpens only the head of the distribution; (d) a dispatcher adds a layer an agent that skips list_skills would also skip; (e) improves precision after retrieval, not retrieval.

THE TEST DESIGN, and the trap it guards: a sentence that merely copies the corpus query passes trivially and a differently-worded user still misses — teaching to the test. So (1) each sentence is written from the tool's PURPOSE in plain words, not tuned to query tokens; (2) the committed corpus is the acceptance test; (3) a second, held-out paraphrase corpus is the honesty check that the sentence generalises, to be authored separately and never used while writing the sentences. The judgement-tier risk fact:skill-mechanics-track-enforcement-exactly-and-they-split-into-three-kinds names — a section written to satisfy a linter — is exactly what (3) exists to catch.

CONSTRAINT MET ON THE WAY: five of the 42 have under 80 chars of headroom under the 1,500-char description budget (detect_gaps 3, loop_status 7, set_verification_status 23, import_graph 25, ingest_corpus_step 46); for those the sentence is bought by trimming, which is a judgement edit and is reviewed as one.
properties.name: DECIDED — a tool's description carries the job in the user's own words, and the 180-query corpus is the test that it was carried honestly
properties.rationale: The measurement settled which option: the register gap is the larger half of the remaining misses and is the half no scorer reaches, so the fix has to live on the tool. The corpus-as-test is Anthony's condition, and it is the same three-legged shape this project holds vocabulary to — a typed carrier (the description), an instruction (this decision), and a detector that notices absence (the corpus test). The held-out paraphrase corpus is added by the agent as the honest bound on the test, because a test the author also wrote the answers to is the weakest evidence in the building.
